draft.title: Aerial and satellite images
card: An aerial photo is taken from an aircraft or drone. A satellite image is taken from space. Both show the land as seen from above.
They show land use, such as farms, houses, roads and bush. They also show landforms, such as rivers, dunes and coastlines.
Images taken in different years can be compared. This shows how a place has changed, such as a town spreading or a forest being cleared.
A map may not show these details, because a map is drawn with set symbols and may be out of date. An image shows what was really there when it was taken.
draft.remember: Images from above show what is on the land and how it changes.

a.q: Why can two satellite images of the same town, taken ten years apart, be useful?
opts: They can be compared to show how the town has changed
They give the exact height of each hill in the town
They show the names of all the streets in the town
They show how many people live in each house
a.why: Comparing images from different times shows change, such as new suburbs. An image does not give exact heights, street names or the number of people.
a.clue: Think about what differs between the two images: the date.

b.q: Priya wants to know if farmland near Toowoomba has been replaced by houses since 2010. Which source is best for this?
opts: Satellite images from 2010 and from this year
A contour map showing the height of the land
A cross-section drawn across the district
A table of the town's yearly rainfall
b.why: Images from two dates show land use at each time, so Priya can see whether farms became houses. Contours, cross-sections and rainfall do not show land use.
b.clue: She needs to see land use at two different times.

a.best: They can be compared to show how the town has changed

b.best: Satellite images from 2010 and from this year

b.q: Priya wants to know if farmland near Toowoomba has been replaced by houses since 2010. Which source is best for this?
opts: Satellite images of the area from 2010 and this year
A satellite image of the area taken this year only
Rainfall records for the area from 2010 and this year
Height measurements of the area from 2010 and this year
